claims.claim: LG Washing machine scrap but doesn’t work and needs repair.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show an LG front-loading washer-dryer with a large glass door and 'DirectDrive 6/3kg' text, but no operation test, no error codes, and no proof of non-working status.

claims.claim: It is an LG DirectDrive 6/3kg front-loading washer-dryer (2-in-1).
claims.evidence: Witness report: LG logo visible on control panel; brand/model text 'DirectDrive 6/3kg' visible; front-loading washer-dryer with large round glass door.

risks.risk: Non-working status may be unproven; could be a simple issue (power, door lock) or could have major faults (motor/control board).
risks.proof: A short video of the machine running a wash cycle and showing the display/program progress (including any error code) plus a spin attempt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / needs repair (worst case), since functionality is not demonstrated.

risks.risk: Drying function may be dead even if washing works (common heating/thermostat/element issues).
risks.proof: A short video starting a dryer cycle (or washer-dryer dry mode) showing heat-up behavior and any dryer-stage indicator; ideally a thermometer reading or steam/heat evidence.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: both wash and dry may be faulty.

risks.risk: Drum interior and door seal condition (rust, stains, tears) could cause leaks, poor performance, or hygiene issues not visible through reflections.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the drum interior and the rubber door seal (straight-on, well-lit) showing any rust, holes, or damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible seal/drum issues until shown otherwise.

risks.risk: Water inlet/drain problems (blocked filter, faulty pump, leaking hoses) could be the real cause of failure.
risks.proof: Photos of inlet hose connections and drain/pump area (where accessible) plus a brief fill/drain test video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: plumbing-related faults possible.

risks.risk: Control board/display faults or sensor errors may not be visible in a static photo.
risks.proof: A photo/video of the display during power-on and during a cycle start, capturing any error codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: electronic fault possible.

risks.risk: Cosmetic scuffing may correlate with rough handling; could also hide dents affecting door alignment or mounting.
risks.proof: Full side/back photos showing dents, warping, and door alignment; plus a close-up of the door latch area.
risks.if_unproven: Price with cosmetic damage treated as minor but not relied upon.

proof_requests: Video of power-on and starting a wash cycle, showing the display and any error code.
Video showing the machine completing a short wash and performing a spin (water draining visible).
If it’s a washer-dryer: video starting a dry cycle and showing dryer-stage progress/heat evidence (or any dryer error code).
Close-up photos of the drum interior and the rubber door seal (straight-on, no reflections).
Photos of inlet hose connections and drain/pump area (where accessible), plus a brief fill/drain test video.
Full photos of sides/back to check for hidden dents or damage around the door/latch and mounting points.
response.reason: The witness can identify the LG DirectDrive 6/3kg washer-dryer, but there is no proof of non-working condition, no error codes, and no functional test. Without a running/diagnostic clip, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
